items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, we used to call him Buddy Luck. I forget his right name, but we used to call him Buddy Luck.

ctx.x: You were talking about Wooden Joe. I'm not sure we got all of the men on. The drummer, who was the drummer with Wooden Joe? Arthur Ogans. Oh yes. And the banjo? John Smith. Yeah, I think we got the others. Did you mention any bass player?
Yeah, we used to call him Buddy Luck. I forget his right name, but we used to call him Buddy Luck.
About where did you play? What kind of jobs? I mean were they?
